name: Dengue Dengue Dengue!
description:
'''Dengue Dengue Dengue!''' is a [[musical duo]] of [[electronic music]] from [[Peru]] established in [[Lima]], made up of Rafael Pereira and Felipe Salmon.

For their concerts they are accompanied by Nadia Escalante, [[Video jockey|VJ]] Sixta. Likewise, a characteristic of their live performances is to appear in masks of colorful and traditional aesthetics.
